2: Repair the shop exported by src/index.mjs. createShop(initial) takes stock by tenant and SKU.

5: A logical request belongs to (tenant, requestId). Repeating it with the same items returns the original receipt without consuming stock. Requests with the same id in different tenants are independent. Reusing a logical id with different totals throws "Conflicting request".

7: Every SKU must exist for that tenant and have sufficient stock. Validate and stage the entire reservation before publishing any stock or request identity. Failure must leave all quantities and ids unchanged so a corrected retry can succeed.
8: The initial stock object and returned receipts are caller-owned snapshots. Preserve the API and repair the connected implementation; utilities and older code may not participate in the active path.

content.text: The active path has three defects: duplicate items overwrite rather than combine, request keys omit the tenant, and stock staging mutates live state. The graph confirms normalization feeds checkout; static analysis leaves built-in and injected calls unresolved, so it does not establish runtime correctness. I’ll repair these points and make sorting deterministic even for distinct SKUs that compare equally under locale collation.
